decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works hereby permitted shall not commence later than the expiration of 3 years beginning with the date on which this consent is granted.

Condition required to be imposed by Section 18(1) (a) of the Planning (Listed Buildings and Conservation Areas) Act 1990 (as amended by section 91 of the Planning and Compensation Act 2004).
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in complete accordance with the following approved drawings, other than where those details are altered pursuant to the conditions of this listed building consent:

26668-00-BW-002;
26668-01-BW-004;
26668-02-BW-006.

To ensure full compliance with the listed building consent application hereby approved and to prevent harm arising through deviations from the approved plans.
Condition : 3 - All new works, and works of making good to the retained fabric, whether internal or external, shall be finished to match the original work and existing adjacent work with regard to the methods used and to material, dimensions, composition, form, colour, finish, texture and profile, and in the case of brickwork, facebond and pointing, unless shown otherwise on the drawings.

In order to safeguard the special architectural and historic interest of the listed building, in accordance with Policies DC1, DC4 and DC8 of the Local Plan (2018).
description: Internal alterations to include: Installation of additional internal riser cupboards at ground, first and second floor levels; formation of limited floor penetrations for vertical service routes; formation of limited wall penetrations for pipework; local making good around the new cupboards and penetrations to match the adjacent finishes; associated internal alterations.
